subject: TEMPLATE AUDIT d-t8: MCM files PASS overall, dad.html has 2 low-priority gaps
body:
TEMPLATE AUDIT REPORT: Visual consistency across MCM HTML files (d-t8)

Commissioned by: GP routing (d-t8-template-audit)
Scope: All HTML files in repo root

AUDIT METHOD
Checked 6 files against template checklist:
  - shared/styles.css linked
  - shared/print.css linked (media="print")
  - shared/scripts.js linked
  - favicon linked
  - lang="en" on <html>
  - viewport meta tag
  - Title format: "Motor City Math — [Page]" (em dash separator)

RESULTS

| File | styles | print | scripts | favicon | lang | viewport | title format |
|------|--------|-------|---------|---------|------|----------|-------------|
| exam.html | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS |
| index.html | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS |
| dad.html | N/A* | N/A* | N/A* | FAIL | PASS | PASS | FAIL |
| nonlinear_exam_mvp.html | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS |
| final_exam_251123.html | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS |
| final_exam_251123_mini.html | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS | PASS |

* dad.html immediately redirects to index.html?dad=1 -- shared CSS not needed.
  The page body shows for ~0ms before redirect fires. N/A for functional purposes.

FINDINGS

1. dad.html favicon: missing (LOW)
   dad.html has no <link rel="icon"> -- browser shows default icon in tab.
   Fix: add <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="shared/favicon.svg"> to dad.html <head>.
   Since the page redirects instantly, Kai rarely sees the tab. Low priority.

2. dad.html title format inconsistency (LOW)
   Current: "MCM - Dad View" (abbreviated, hyphen-minus)
   Standard: "Motor City Math — [Page]" (full name, em dash)
   Fix: <title>Motor City Math — Dad View</title>
   This affects browser history/bookmarks if Marcus bookmarks the page.

OVERALL VERDICT: MCM template consistency is HIGH. Core student pages (exam, index, archives)
are all fully compliant. Only dad.html (a redirect page, non-student-facing) has minor gaps.

GD RECOMMENDATION: Fix both dad.html items in one small commit.
They are 2-line changes. GD can make these if GA approves (GD does not own dad.html).
Or GA can implement -- either works, changes are cosmetic and low-risk.
